response.sql: WITH by_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS trade_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT trade_count, trade_count * 1.0 / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(trade_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM by_type) SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(trade_count - average_count) AS average_amount_above FROM stats WHERE trade_count > average_count
